summary:
Unity Global Trading Sdn. Bhd., incorporated in Selangor since June 2018, operates as a private limited company retailing textiles and baju kurung. The business is owned by four individual shareholders who are also directors, with Director 4 holding the largest stake at 58.25%. Financial records cover fiscal years ending June 30 for 2022 through 2024, all audited unqualifiedly by Audit Firm 8. Revenue grew from RM5.1 million in FY2022 to RM5.4 million in FY2024, while net profit margins remained low between 1.8% and 2.2%. Free cash flow was negative across all three years, ranging from a loss of RM9k in FY2023 to RM240k in FY2024 due to high capital expenditure relative to operating inflows.

No court cases are recorded for the company. However, persistent negative free cash flow and elevated days sales outstanding suggest liquidity pressure despite adequate current assets. The reliance on a single audit firm over three years warrants attention regarding independence standards. Operating expenses as a percentage of revenue increased significantly in FY2024 compared to prior periods.

Further review should investigate the causes behind widening operating expense ratios, verify the sustainability of negative free cash flow trends, and assess whether the concentration of ownership among directors impacts governance or strategic decision-making processes effectively.
